plugins.name: coalboard
plugins.description: Diverse-lens consensus & debate board. Its primary auto-trigger is error-not-allowed work (security/crypto, migrations, high-precision math); convened manually it generalizes to any hard problem worth several perspectives — generate new work, or audit/review existing work. Opinion lane: an uncertain-decision ask gains an "ask CB" option (~4 lenses + judge); the pick IS the consent, never auto-convened. With consent it convenes diverse epistemic lenses in parallel (empirical/source-grounded, formal, a show-me skeptic), a judge synthesizes on VERIFIED inputs, an independent out-of-frame solver breaks ties, and the human signs off. Guarantees bounded cost (no whack-a-mole) and zero-breakage (staging); improves correctness without claiming a reliability number. Off ~90% of the time. Cross-agent (verified: Claude Code + Antigravity; others designed-for, unverified; Claude Code adds cost-optimized tiering). Zero-dependency, offline, no API keys.
